effect.name: GM Channel Swap
effect.desc: Five ways to rearrange the colour channels. Rotate Cycles the channels round, Channel Mixer is a full 3x3 matrix so any output channel can be rebuilt from any mix of the inputs, Swap Pairs trades two channels at a time, Invert Mask flips any combination of R/G/B with a 3-bit mask, and Luma Split holds the brightness exactly and spins only the chroma through YCbCr. Runs on the layer's own pixels through the layer transform, so it keeps working when the layer is moved, scaled or rotated.
